## Publisher, rights, and data

- [ ] I have authority to submit this package; the source repository and maintenance contact are provided.
- [ ] The applicable plugin/asset licenses and required dependency notices are available for review and included in the distribution where required.
- [ ] Screenshots and examples use sample data and contain no secrets or private personal data.
- [ ] The description discloses data sent off-device, destinations, external providers, required keys/accounts/payments, and relevant privacy information.
- [ ] Permission, grant, destination, publisher, and source changes are listed explicitly below, including when there are none.

Changes to access, destinations, or ownership:

## Verification evidence

- [ ] The submitted bundle corresponds to reviewable source, lockfile, and documented build commands.
- [ ] Package bytes and manifest match this entry; existing released versions have not been replaced.
- [ ] Local validation, tests, and the remote package check pass. Attach the relevant output or CI run.
- [ ] The actual package was tested in a supported desktop version, including failure/cancellation and update behavior. Record version, OS, and results below.
- [ ] I read [PUBLISHING_POLICY.md](../PUBLISHING_POLICY.md) and know how to report an incident through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Desktop test evidence and any untested behavior:

## Maintainer review

For the independent reviewer: record the source revision and package hash reviewed, unresolved concerns, and the approval or rejection in the PR review. Passing CI and the submitter's checkboxes are not release approval. Re-review changes pushed after approval.
